mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses discount rates and stimulates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This is a persistent trend signal without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 0.5% occurs in 80% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 3.0% YoY occurs in 70% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% and rise in federal funds rate above 3.0% indicates an overheating economy with tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (UNRATE<4.0 and FEDFUNDS>3.0) occurs in 60% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) combined with slowing GDP growth (GDPC1) signals an impending economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The late-cycle expansion regime (HOUST rising and GDPC1 decelerating) occurs in 50% of cases but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payroll employment increase above 150,000 jobs per month signals robust labor market conditions and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS above 150,000 occurs in 70% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (index, 2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO below 95.0 occurs in 65% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in retail sales (RSAFS) below 600,000 million dollars and year-over-year CPI above 3.5% signals weak consumer demand amid high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (RSAFS<600000 and CPIAUCSL>3.5% YoY) occurs in 55% of cases but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and CPIAUCSL > 4.0% YoY), aggressive rate hikes combined with persistent inflation lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The high-inflation monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS>3.0% and CPIAUCSL>4.0% YoY) occurs in 40% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 35% of those instances.
